excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了敬畏生命议案，将禁止允许政策。

我们的帝国目前不符合该项议案决定。是否要据此调整政策？
excerpt.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Reverence for Life resolution, banning the Allowed policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

label.zh: 我们将保持现有的政策不变。
